title: CAD v15 (RT-14 draft, 1S4P pack)
description: DesktopSpeaker internal CAD v15: board RT-14 routing draft + models-v13 accurate models; enclosure with the 1S4P battery cradle (owner decision 2026-11-03)

spec.v: 1S4P, 4 x INR21700-50S, 20 Ah / 72 Wh nominal; brick 86.85 x 74.47 x 21.75 mm; PCM at the rear against the partition

source.models: ai-files/cad/models-v13/3d/ (board models via the project library, enclosure models read directly)

frame.cad: X right (long side), Y depth (0 = front outer face, + = rear), Z up (0 = outer bottom of the box)
frame.front: +z in glTF (front baffle at z = 0, rear lid outer face at z = -206.6)
frame.ground: feet bottoms at y = -15, box bottom at y = 0

pcb.units: mm (root node PCB_<board> carries scale 1000 on the KiCad metre data)

transform.note: already applied in the file: load both files unchanged and they overlay

pcb.content: kicad-cli pcb export glb --subst-models --include-pads --include-soldermask --include-silkscreen; components by reference designator

pcb_copper.content: tracks + zones (outer layers) of the RT-14 routing draft (12 connections still open), same frame; optional layer: load on demand (not counted in the 40 MB budget)

viewer_notes: Plain glTF 2.0, no extensions (three.js r128 GLTFLoader).
Materials are doubleSided so clipped sections show inner faces.
Explode: add node.userData.explode_mm (mesh nodes in enclosure.glb) to node.position; move the pcb.glb root by [0, 60, 0].

Per-node provenance is in node extras (userData): model_source, accuracy (<0.5mm = compared with a drawing/standard in the models-v13 audit | estimated = known deviation or placeholder for an unselected part | unverified = no drawing), accuracy_note.
Soldermask and silkscreen materials are translucent (alpha 0.83 / 0.9, alphaMode BLEND).

groups.description: Printed main shell: front baffle, walls, driver pads, square woofer seat with 4 outside insert bosses, lid bosses, feet bosses, battery cradle, encoder knob dish
Printed rear lid 4 mm: USB-C, 2 jacks, SW100, rocker cutouts; gasket groove
Printed sealed woofer chamber insert (partition, walls, roof, PCB shelf, PCB screw bosses); bonded into the shell
Two Dayton Audio ND65-4 full-range drivers (maker STEP)
Tang Band W3-2052SC down-firing woofer (models-v13: square 82.55 frame, 68.25 square hole pattern, factory 3.3 mm gasket; seller data + photo estimates)

1S4P vendor-built brick: 4 x Samsung INR21700-50S (models-v13 cell, datasheet max 21.25 x 70.62) side by side, axes front to back, positive ends at the rear; spot-welded nickel (negative strip; positive pads with per-cell fusible links and bus bar) over fish paper, PCM 60 x 18 on the positive end against the woofer-chamber partition, 103AT NTC between the middle cells, 0.25 mm heat-shrink wrap (translucent here), 20 mm hook-and-loop strap; seated in the printed saddle cradle (PCM/holder are placeholders)

Real wires (swept insulation, colours, bend radius >= 6 x OD except where reported), crimps and housings: J5 Molex Micro-Fit 43645-0300 to the pack PCM; J9/J10 JST VHR-2N to the ND65 solder tabs; J11 VHR-2N adapter through the Heyco grommet to the woofer pigtail (JST PH)
ISO 4762 screws, Ruthex M3x5.7 inserts, Wurth hex spacers and foot studs (models-v13), rubber discs, lid gasket, grommet
Encoder knob stand-in (not selected), SW101 CW GRB112B802BR1 rocker (models-v13), front and woofer perforated grilles

pcb_group.description: Board RT-14 routing draft (12 unconnected, DRC 0) with the models-v13 corrected library models (J1, J5, J9-J11, SW100, TP1-TP27, U1 offset, U2, U24) and the RT-14 footprint fixes (J2/J3, U1 pad 56, SW100, C275)

fit_findings.title: SW100: actuator at the board edge, still 4.50 mm behind the lid outer face (lid plunger needed)
fit_findings.detail: RT-14 redrawn TE 1977066-1 footprint moved the switch 2.295 mm toward the rear edge (y 25.245 -> 22.95). Measured in CAD: actuator (dia 2.0, axis 1.70 above the board top, X -14.68 Z 70.30) tip at Y 202.10 = board rear edge (0.00 mm past it), 0.50 mm short of the lid inner face (Y 202.6) and 4.50 mm behind the lid outer face (Y 206.6). v13 (draft footprint): 2.80 / 6.80 mm. The 5.0 bore is centred on the actuator axis (radial 1.5); the nearest switch geometry is 1.35 mm from the lid. A fingertip cannot reach it: a printed plunger must bridge 4.50 mm (lid 4.0 + 0.5 gap) plus its own protrusion and travel. Only 0.5 mm is free behind the lid, so a retaining collar would need a counterbore in the lid inner face (owner decision; not modelled, v14 keeps the v13 lid). Switch travel not extracted (TE PDF is a drawing without text).

fit_findings.title: 1S4P vendor-built brick seated in the saddle cradle (0 interference)
fit_findings.detail: Cells: models-v13 INR21700-50S at datasheet max (21.25 x 70.62), positive buttons toward the PCM (rear), negative ends toward the baffle. Pack: 0.15 nickel strip on the negative ends; fish paper 0.25 with button holes; positive nickel pads with a 1.0 x 3.4 mm fusible neck per cell to a common bus bar; PCM 60 x 18 x 1.6 + parts; 103AT NTC (dia 2.4) between cells 2 and 3 at mid-length with its lead to the PCM; 0.25 mm heat-shrink with 3 mm end rims and a lead-exit slit. Brick 86.85 x 74.47 x 21.75. Cradle: the v13p4 saddle profile followed each cell and its inter-cell peaks pressed 278 mm3 into the wrap; v15 uses a stadium saddle (outer arcs + flat bottom): radial clearance 0.275 mm (nominal 0.2-0.3), front gap 0.60 mm to the fingers, rear gap 0.63 mm to the partition (rear stop). Clearances: cells to ND65 5.29, PCB 41.27, J5 wires 0.1.

fit_findings.title: ND65-4 terminals are two flat solder tabs: wires are soldered (no quick-connect)
fit_findings.detail: Measured on the Dayton maker STEP: a terminal strip on top of the basket with two flat tabs about 1.95 x 0.5 mm, pointing rearward, 7.6 / 7.0 mm either side of the axis, tips 21.1 / 22.4 mm behind the flange face, top 27 mm above the axis. The spec sheet drawing shows two solder lugs with holes; no faston size. Polarity marking is not in the STEP or the spec sheet: check the red dot / + on the part.

fit_findings.title: J5 receptacle faces the right wall: first bend R 9.5 (5.3 x OD) for the 18 AWG leads
fit_findings.detail: The RA header mates along +X; the 43645-0300 (estimated 5.0 mm outside the header) ends at x 67.45 with the wall inner face at 78.5: 11.05 mm for the 90 deg bend down. 6 x OD (OD 1.8) needs 11.7 mm. Options: thin-wall 18 AWG OD <= 1.7 (6 x OD = 10.2, fits), accept 5.3 x OD (silicone wire tolerates it), or rotate J5 on the next board revision.

fit_findings.title: Countersunk post-Torx T10 M3x10 (owner choice): lid flush, ND65 sites on cup washers
fit_findings.detail: Vendor page: head 5.90 x 2.00, 90 deg, T10 post (pin) Torx, A2-70, full thread, overall length incl. head; MPNs YCXSA2M3X6...X25. Lid: 11 x 6.0 x 90 deg countersinks (0.6 counterbore + cone to the 3.4 hole), head flush; thread below the lid inner face 6.0 mm (insert 5.7 fully engaged, tip 2.0 above the pilot floor). Drivers: the ND65 flange is 0.75 mm with 4.2 holes, so no countersink can be cut; an M3 stainless cup (finishing) washer about 8 x 1.6 carries the head (head tip 0.4 mm into the flange hole); thread below the pad face 7.65 mm, insert fully engaged. M3x10 is correct at both sites; M3x8 would leave 4.0 / 5.65 mm. The 11 nylon lid washers cannot be used under a flush head: seal the lid holes inside the gasket loops with sealant. PCB (M3x16) and woofer (M3x20) screws unchanged.

fit_findings.title: Woofer lead: PH 2 A rating and the adapter
fit_findings.detail: The adapter (VH at J11, 20 AWG, splice to 24 AWG, inline PH male) mates the woofer pigtail PHR-2 inside the chamber at x 53, z 40, y 135-148. JST PH is rated 2 A at 24 AWG: fine for the woofer AGL ceiling (about 10 W into 4 ohm = 1.6 A RMS), marginal above 16 W. Alternative: cut the PH plug and splice the pigtail directly to the 20 AWG pair. The grommet moved from (40, 40) to (50, 47) on the partition so the J5 leads pass under its boss and the pair reaches the free side band of the chamber.

fit_findings.title: TP20 moved 40.8 mm (RT-14) clears every enclosure body
fit_findings.detail: TP20 (Keystone 5015, 1.5 above the board) from (110.155, 149.645) to (123.9, 111.25): nearest body the H4 PCB spacer 8.54 mm (its M3x16 head 8.77), 11.6 mm to the insert roof under the board, 11.99 mm to the shell; woofer harness tube 70.6 mm (J5 harness farther); 26.9 mm under the top wall. In v13 it was 22.9 mm from the shell.

fit_findings.title: Woofer screws: M3x20 gives only 3.4-4.4 mm thread in the 5.7 mm insert (unchanged from v13)
fit_findings.detail: Stack: head on the frame back (z 19.60) through the 13.3 frame block and the 3.3 gasket. M3x20 engages 3.4 mm with the gasket free, 4.4 mm with 1 mm compression (1.1-1.5 d; tip 2.3 mm above the pilot floor). Raising the seat to fit longer screws pushes the magnet into the roof (3.25 mm left). Options: accept M3x20 (gasket compresses), or M3x22 (DIN 912; 5.4-6.4 mm, still inside the 6.7 pilot) if the owner can source it. Frame thickness and gasket are photo estimates (+-1.5): measure before printing.
